WITH patient_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    AVG(CASE WHEN l.ALB IS NOT NULL AND l.TP IS NOT NULL THEN l.ALB - l.TP END) as alb_tp_diff,
    AVG(CASE WHEN l.APPT IS NOT NULL AND l.PT IS NOT NULL THEN l.APPT - l.PT END) as appt_pt_diff
  FROM Patient p
  INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
sex_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    SEX,
    AVG(alb_tp_diff) as sex_alb_tp_avg,
    AVG(appt_pt_diff) as sex_appt_pt_avg
  FROM patient_avgs
  GROUP BY SEX
),
global_mean_appt AS (
  SELECT AVG(sex_appt_pt_avg) as mean_appt_pt
  FROM sex_avgs
),
filtered_sexes AS (
  SELECT s.*
  FROM sex_avgs s
  WHERE s.sex_appt_pt_avg > (SELECT mean_appt_pt FROM global_mean_appt)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(sex_alb_tp_avg) as alb_tp_average,
  AVG(sex_appt_pt_avg) as appt_pt_average,
  AVG(sex_appt_pt_avg) - (SELECT mean_appt_pt FROM global_mean_appt) as excess_over_mean
FROM filtered_sexes

assumptions.assumption: Averages are unweighted: sex-level figures are simple arithmetic means of the per-patient figures (not weighted by the number of patients per sex), and the global mean is an unweighted mean of the sex-level APPT−PT values.
Each patient ID has a single, consistent SEX value in the Patient table (no duplicate or conflicting records per patient).

alternatives.interpretation: If sex-level and global averages should be weighted by the number of patients per sex, compute the mean APPT−PT across all sexes as a population-weighted average, and similarly weight the final aggregation across filtered sexes.
alternatives.sql:
WITH patient_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    AVG(CASE WHEN l.ALB IS NOT NULL AND l.TP IS NOT NULL THEN l.ALB - l.TP END) as alb_tp_diff,
    AVG(CASE WHEN l.APPT IS NOT NULL AND l.PT IS NOT NULL THEN l.APPT - l.PT END) as appt_pt_diff
  FROM Patient p
  INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
sex_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SEX,
    AVG(alb_tp_diff) as sex_alb_tp_avg,
    AVG(appt_pt_diff) as sex_appt_pt_avg,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ID) as num_patients
  FROM patient_avgs
  GROUP BY SEX
),
global_mean_weighted AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(sex_appt_pt_avg * num_patients) / SUM(num_patients) as overall_mean
  FROM sex_stats
),
filtered_sexes AS (
  SELECT ss.*
  FROM sex_stats ss
  WHERE ss.sex_appt_pt_avg > (SELECT overall_mean FROM global_mean_weighted)
)
SELECT 
  SUM(sex_alb_tp_avg * num_patients) / SUM(num_patients) as alb_tp_average,
  SUM(sex_appt_pt_avg * num_patients) / SUM(num_patients) as appt_pt_average,
  SUM(sex_appt_pt_avg * num_patients) / SUM(num_patients) - (SELECT overall_mean FROM global_mean_weighted) as excess_over_mean
FROM filtered_sexes
